app_info.subtitle: Audit Austin open data
app_info.description: Civic Data Health helps users find City of Austin open datasets, inspect metadata health, compare quality risks, review schemas and sample rows, and answer conservative row-count questions against public Socrata data. The app is read-only and uses public Austin open-data catalog and dataset APIs.

test_cases.description: Find the best Austin datasets for a civic data question.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Civic Data Health to find Austin datasets about building permits and explain which one is best for permit volume questions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns ranked Austin building permit datasets with source links, quality caveats, and a recommendation for permit volume analysis.

test_cases.description: Answer a conservative row-count question from public Socrata data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Civic Data Health, how many building permits were issued in Austin in 2025?
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the relevant dataset, applies a validated date field when available, returns a count, source URL, and caveats.

test_cases.description: Review the highest-impact metadata cleanup opportunities.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Civic Data Health to show the top actionable metadata fixes for active Austin datasets.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists active datasets with issue codes, remediation guidance, scores, labels, and public source links.

test_cases.description: Search catalog and schema knowledge together.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Civic Data Health to find Austin homelessness service datasets and include schema or field caveats when available.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant datasets, matching schema fields when available, health labels, and caveats about data quality or answerability.

test_cases.description: Inspect one dataset's health and issue remediation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Civic Data Health to inspect dataset abcd-1234 and explain any health issues and category suggestions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the dataset health record, issue explanations, recommended metadata fixes, and category suggestion evidence if present.

test_cases.description: Retrieve schema and sample rows for a known Austin dataset.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Civic Data Health to show the schema and a few sample rows for a relevant Austin public safety dataset.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds a public safety dataset, returns column metadata, and includes a small bounded sample from the public Socrata API.

test_cases.description: Use compatibility search and fetch for citation-friendly retrieval.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Civic Data Health search and fetch to get a citation-friendly Austin building permits record.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns search results with ids, titles, and URLs, then fetches one result with full text and metadata for citation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for out-of-scope statewide data requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find State of Texas public datasets about procurement vendors.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the current submitted scope is City of Austin public open data, not statewide Texas data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not attempt to update source catalog metadata.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use Civic Data Health to fix the missing category on the Austin dataset and publish the change.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should explain that it is read-only and cannot publish changes to Austin or Socrata metadata.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use Civic Data Health to email the department owner and tell them to fix this dataset.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not send email; it may state that it can draft outreach text only if the user asks for a draft.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated personal productivity requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings are on my calendar tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar data is outside its supported public-data workflows.
